Now I have a clear picture. Let me implement the motion preference module first.
## A11Y-3 Implementation Report

### Outcome

Implemented A11Y-3: surface-aware focus tokens, semantic contrast auditing, 44 px target auditing, and an install-level reduced-motion preference with an Appearance toggle in Settings. Reduced motion now suppresses the named animation categories and is propagated to the board scene, while auto-pan remains an instant camera jump.

### Acceptance criteria evidence

| Criterion | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Every semantic body/control pair ≥ 4.5:1, large headings ≥ 3:1 | **PASS** | `tests/a11y/contrast.test.ts` computes 71 pairs from semantic tokens against every dark surface, the sepia paper surface, and all status/action surfaces. Examples: ink/surface 12.14:1, muted/surface 7.87:1, heading/canvas 15.27:1, paper ink/paper 12.99:1, accent ink/accent 7.77:1. |
| Every interactive fixture ≥ 44×44 or has an expanded hit area | **PASS** | `tests/a11y/targets.test.ts` renders Button, IconButton, Dialog, Toast, Field, EmptyState, Settings appearance toggle, SearchPanel filters/result/remove controls, and TagInput, then audits the CSS geometry of all primary interactive selectors. |
| Motion toggle persists, follows system default until changed, applies without reload | **PASS** | `tests/a11y/reducedMotion.test.tsx` covers OS default, explicit persisted choice, remount read-back, live OS change, immediate root attribute update, and keyboard activation with Space. |
| Reduced motion removes required animation classes and disables auto-pan | **PASS** | CSS contract covers pin drop, string draw, auto-pan, page transition, and pulse under both `prefers-reduced-motion` and `[data-motion='reduced']`; `motionBehavior(true)` returns suppressed/instant, and the board stage exposes `data-motion-auto-pan="instant"`. |
| Focus rings visible in both themes and on all surfaces | **PASS (with product note)** | The product is the single Midnight Archive dark theme, so “both themes” is implemented as dark surfaces plus the sepia paper reading surface. New `--color-focus-ring-on-paper` and `--color-focus-ring-on-warning` tokens pass 3:1 on their surfaces; the OCR paper textarea and quiet suggestion button now use the paper ring and paper ink. |

### Keyboard and viewport exercise

- **Keyboard:** Settings → Appearance → “Reduce motion” was focused and toggled with `Space`; focus remained on the checkbox, the announcement updated, and the preference persisted. The full component suite, including `tests/a11y/keyboard.test.tsx`, passes.
- **Viewports:** No new browser viewport matrix was run for A11Y-3. The target/contrast evidence is CSS-contract plus jsdom fixture evidence; live 390×844 / 768×1024 / 1280×800 / 1440×900 geometry remains with the responsive Playwright and axe gates (A11Y-1/A11Y-4/QA).

### Accessibility evidence

- **Focus:** The motion checkbox gets the shared 3 px focus ring (`#8fd3ff` on the sunken control surface, 10.46:1) and the whole 44 px label row is the hit target.
- **Announcements:** The motion status is a mounted `aria-live="polite"`, `aria-atomic="true"` region; it updates without moving focus. The existing Settings `role="status"` region remains empty initially, so existing announcement tests are unchanged.
- **Targets:** `.appearance-settings__toggle` has 44 px min block/inline; existing 44 px controls were re-audited, including navigation, board controls, sheets, search chips, tag removal, connection rows, backup choices, capture toggles, and error/skip actions.
- **Contrast:** Focus ring on canvas 11.20:1; paper focus ring on paper 6.62:1; paper focus ring on paper edge 3.68:1; warning focus ring 8.54:1.
- **Motion policy:** The OS preference is a hard floor. The toggle can persist an explicit reduction but cannot re-enable full motion against a device that asks for reduced motion; the control is checked and disabled with an explanatory note in that case.

### Shared-file handoffs

- `src/features/case/CaseBoardPage.tsx` — added `useMotionPreference()` / `motionBehavior()` and `data-motion` / `data-motion-auto-pan` on the board stage. Preserve when editing the board composition.
- `src/board/BoardCanvas.tsx` — replaced the local media-query hook with the shared motion store, added the optional `motionStore` prop, `data-motion`, `data-motion-auto-pan`, and the motion-intent classes. Preserve the `reducedMotion` pass-through to `usePixiApp`.
- `src/app/AppShell.tsx` — added `motion-page-transition` to the main landmark. Preserve.
- `src/features/case/TopicStatusBadge.tsx` — added the `motion-pulse` marker class. Preserve.
- `src/main.tsx` — calls `ensureMotionPreference()` before render. Foundation owner should preserve the pre-render bootstrap.
- `src/features/ocr/OcrPanel.css` — paper focus ring and paper-surface quiet-button treatment; OCR owner should preserve.
- `tests/ocr/OcrPanel.test.tsx` — updated the focus-ring assertion to the stricter paper token.
- `src/features/connections/connections.css`, `src/features/backup/BackupDialog.css` — added explicit 44 px inline floors to full-width labels.

### Files created

- `src/app/motionPreference.ts`
- `src/features/settings/settings.css`
- `tests/a11y/contrast.test.ts`
- `tests/a11y/targets.test.ts`
- `tests/a11y/reducedMotion.test.tsx`

### Files changed

- `src/styles/tokens.css`
- `src/styles/base.css`
- `src/features/settings/SettingsPage.tsx`
- `src/features/ocr/OcrPanel.css`
- `src/features/connections/connections.css`
- `src/features/backup/BackupDialog.css`
- `src/board/BoardCanvas.tsx`
- `src/features/case/CaseBoardPage.tsx`
- `src/features/case/TopicStatusBadge.tsx`
- `src/app/AppShell.tsx`
- `src/main.tsx`
- `tests/ocr/OcrPanel.test.tsx`

### Validation

- `npm test -- tests/a11y/contrast.test.ts tests/a11y/targets.test.ts tests/a11y/reducedMotion.test.tsx` → **exit 0, 98 tests passed**
- `npm run typecheck` → **exit 0**
- `npm test` → **exit 0, 1117 tests passed**
- `npm run lint` → **exit 0, 3 pre-existing `RecallSummary` warnings, no errors**
- `npm run format:check` → **exit 0**
- `npm run build` → **exit 0**

### Known limitations / human review

- No new Playwright journey or axe scan was added; A11Y-3 is scoped to component/CSS evidence. Browser viewport geometry, axe, and real focus-ring rendering remain A11Y-4/QA and human review.
- The sepia paper focus-ring color and OCR quiet-button treatment are new visual choices that meet contrast but should be included in the human style gate.
- The app is intentionally single-theme (Midnight Archive); the “both themes” criterion was interpreted as dark surfaces plus the sepia paper reading surface, since adding a competing light theme would contradict the locked FND-5 direction.
- `docs/EXECUTION-AUDIT.jsonl` and `docs/WORKFLOW-STATE.json` were already engine-modified and were not touched.

handoff.summary: Implemented A11Y-3: surface-aware focus tokens, semantic 4.5:1/3:1 contrast auditing, 44 px target auditing, an install-level motion preference with an Appearance toggle that defaults to the OS setting and persists an explicit reduce choice, reduced-motion CSS/board hand-off for pin/string/auto-pan/page/pulse, and 98 targeted tests; full suite, typecheck, lint, format, and build pass.
decisions: The OS reduce-motion request is a hard floor; the Appearance toggle can add a persisted reduce choice but cannot re-enable full motion against the platform setting. The control is checked and disabled with an explanatory note when the device asks for reduced motion.

A shared motion store applies data-motion on the document root; base.css contains both a media-query fallback for the pre-hydration frame and a [data-motion='reduced'] rule for immediate in-app changes.

Focus rings are surface-aware: the existing light ring covers dark surfaces and new dark rings cover sepia paper and the amber status chip; the OCR suggestion quiet button now uses paper ink so it is readable on paper.

Named motion-intent classes (pin drop, string draw, auto-pan, page transition, pulse) are applied to the board, route main, and status badge so future animations cannot bypass the reduced-motion rule.
Auto-pan is an instant camera jump in v1; motionBehavior(true).autoPan is 'instant' and the board stage exposes data-motion-auto-pan='instant'.
